changeinfo.changes:
The following changes have been made:
  • Added 7 new language locales! (French, Spanish, German, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese).
  • Updated Trophy Set to be localized for the above languages.
  • Added a new Language Settings screen to the Title Screen (auto shown if never seen before).
  • Added horizontal text scrolling to several menus.
  • Fixed a bug where healing from items used before using a Warp Shard would not be applied.
  • Adjusted UI spacing of wide buttons glyphs in text.
  • Updated the credits to include the Localization team.
  • Added 2 new Passwords to the game to allow improved Speed Running experiences.
  • Fixed a bug where the Spotlight SFX sound could continue to play after defeating the Demon Boss.
  • Fixed an issue where you could lock the Demon Boss out of its first usage of its critical attack.
  • Fixed a bug where opening a Max HP/Aura/Sand chest could reset your HP/Aura/Sand to a previous state.
  • Changed the START button to now completely exit from menus.
  • Added a new item to the Merchant Crow shop under certain circumstances.
  • Added new items that increase Familiar experience and experience gain.
  • Lowered Familiar level up exp requirements.
  • Improved framerate during a certain boss battle.
  • Fixed a bug where Junk Crushers would be invisible if unseen before frozen.
  • Fixed a bug where Reinforcing an Orb would reset your HP/MP to the values you had the last time you Paused.
  • Fixed a bug where level 1 clears weren't being saved properly.
  • Buffed a few healing items.
  • Added a cutscene to remind players to use the Timespinner.
  • Added a new "Dropped Item" for a quest item, in addition to the original method to get it.

The following changes have been made:
  • Optimized memory management greatly (large decrease in hitches from garbage collection)
  • Adjusted text in a collectable Letter.

The following changes have been made:
  • Fixed a crash caused by the Moon Orb hitting too many enemies at once.
  • Fixed a crash caused by Mushroom Towers being hit by friendly fire.
  • Fixed a crash caused by raising Orb Level too high. It is now capped at 999.
  • Fixed a bug where Continuing after a Game-Over would not reset your explored map.
  • Fixed a bug where the player would not be teleported to the correct spot for a certain quest in certain situations.
  • Fixed a bug with "forever run" enemies where they could get stuck in walls.
  • Fixed a bug with "forever run" enemies where they could get stuck in doorways
  • Fixed a bug where the Lab Turret tracks would stop rendering if dead and you went out of view
  • Fixed a bug where switching out a specific Orb mid-attack left behind a damage area briefly.
  • Fixed a bug where the Familiar would be invisible after a quest cutscene
  • Fixed a bug where level 1 clears weren't being saved.
  • Fixed an issue where NG+ would clear KS Backer Familiar Skin relics.
  • Fixed a few visual environment mistakes.
  • Fixed a visual bug in the Orb Shop where the "Better Arrow" would overlap the Orb level
  • Fixed several text typos.
  • Adjusted the Fire Passive to be capable of killing enemies (it would not reduce them past 1 HP before).
  • Adjusted the Orb Shop's Reinforce display stats to always show improvement, even if numbers did not visibly change.
  • Adjusted the spawn probablity logic around a certain foe encounter
  • Adjusted collision properties of the Gun Orb.
  • Adjusted the background parralax for a certain cutscene
  • Adjusted controls for jumping down from ledge grabbing.
  • Adjusted Chucklefish logo
  • Adjusted stats on a few enemies.
  • Added text scrolling for player stats that were too long
  • Added "Dropped Items" to help people find their way in a couple locations.
  • Added glowing floor prompts to two story interactable objects.
  • Added FNA logo to credits
  • Added a few new SFX
  • Added an additional costume for Lunais.
  • Added a Yellow Dot to the Map in a particular room.
  • Added color fade oscillation for Map Markers in the Map Screen (helps with Markers cover map)
  • Sorted the large Kickstarter Backer section alphabetically
  • Entering a NG+ game no longer clears the "Game Cleared" flag- allowing for infinite NG+ resets.
  • Reduced the power of several healing items.
  • Optimized Conveyor Belts to be more efficient (improves fps)
  • Optimized Donut Floors to be more efficient (improves fps)
  • Optimized memory management (improves hitches from garbage collection)
Fixed an issue where the Relic "Jewelry Box" referred to the L2/R2 buttons instead of the SELECT button.
